picture.description: NASA artist's rendering of a conceptual lunar habitation module on the lunar surface (image page "Conceptual Lunar Habitation Module", https://www.nasa.gov/image-detail/corehab-beautyshot/); before sending, the picture was cropped to the module and everything outside it painted white

simplifications: The picture shows one end and one long side of the module, so the generator guessed the other end, the far side and the underside.
The open frame, its braces and the thin rails are rough or merged into the body, and some surfaces are torn.
The shaded space under the round end could not be told apart from shaded ground, so it was left in the picture; the frame there may come out more closed than it is.
No size is published for this concept: the 4.0 m height is our estimate, and the length and width are measured from the shape scaled to it.
All colours, textures and markings removed; one plain grey material.

finishing.material: one neutral material; every texture, image, UV coordinate, per-vertex colour and original material removed
